meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在一个已装 Dial 的安装上再多加一个电话号码。每个号码是独立线路，短信或 AI 语音来电会进入对应线路，回复也从被联系的那个号码发出。原有线路不变。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已经装好，你想给它再加一个电话号码（比如个人线之外再加一条支持线），或直接说“加一个号码”时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Dial 上再加一个号码 +14155550123。
say.note: 会开始添加流程，要求选代理组等。

say.text: 把新号码设为 strict 模式，只允许已知联系人。
say.note: 设置访问策略为仅限已知用户。

say.text: 给新线路起名叫“销售热线”，接到客服组。
say.note: 设置线路名称并接入指定代理组。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can add another phone number to an existing Dial channel. Each number is a separate line; inbound calls/texts route there, and replies use the number contacted. Existing lines unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an extra number (e.g. personal plus support line), or says 'add a number'.

say_en.text: Add another Dial number +14155550123 for me.
say_en.note: Starts the add flow, asks to choose agent group.

say_en.text: Set the new number to strict mode, only known contacts.
Name the new line 'Sales Hotline' and route it to the support group.
say_en.note: Sets line name and wires to agent group.
